name: UCR STEM Summer Camp (wildfire science)
org: UC Riverside, College of Natural and Agricultural Sciences (XCITE Center)
what_you_do: A 5-day hands-on camp on the science of fighting wildfires. You use drone images, 3D video, data science, Python coding, maps and AI tools. Lunch is provided.
who_can_apply: Current high school students in the Inland Empire. No grades or ages are listed.
pay_detail: Cost not listed on the camp page.
duration: 5 days, 9 AM to 4 PM (June 22 to 26 in 2026)
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The 2026 camp ran June 22 to 26, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Register Now form on the camp page. Email stemsummercamp@ucr.edu or call the XCITE Center at (951) 827-2612.
notes: The 2026 theme was The Science of Fighting Wildfires. Location in 2026: Tomas Rivera Library, 900 University Ave, Riverside. Confirm first: no cost is stated, and the page does not say whether the theme changes each year.
